config.$comment: Pre-registered design (sized for a short report). Factors, levels and replications are fixed BEFORE any run; the analysis reads this file, so no cell can be quietly dropped.

strategies.naive: Baseline. READ COMMITTED: SELECT status; check in application code; unconditional UPDATE. The 'feral' read-check-write pattern.
strategies.conditional_update: CineBook's design. One UPDATE … WHERE status='AVAILABLE' RETURNING; all-or-nothing by comparing the row count.
strategies.pessimistic_sorted: SELECT … FOR UPDATE on all requested seats in one statement ordered by seat (consistent lock order), then UPDATE.
strategies.pessimistic_unordered: SELECT … FOR UPDATE one seat at a time in the client's request order (inconsistent lock order).
strategies.optimistic_version: Read status+version without locks; UPDATE … WHERE version = read version (Kung & Robinson style validation).
strategies.serializable: The naive read-check-write code, but under SERIALIZABLE isolation (PostgreSQL SSI).
strategies.advisory_lock: Coarse pessimism: pg_advisory_xact_lock(showtime) then naive read-check-write.
